answer: The ferrous schedule is applied in plume and grove publishes each instalment. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 997 identities would post 3340 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
